content.text: In countries where traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, building a reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|COREMERCH guide to payments]]-what-actually-how-5|digital]] store becomes a challenge. With COREMERCH, you can establish a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-7|Sovereign Commerce]] crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, bypassing these restrictions entirely. This guide will walk you through the infrastructure setup, ensuring your digital products are delivered seamlessly and your payments processed automatically. Get ready to take control of your online business with a robust solution that prioritizes ownership and independence.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators face significant barriers when trying to monetize their work due to restrictive payment platforms. COREMERCH provides an alternative by leveraging decentralized blockchain technology. This infrastructure empowers creators by eliminating reliance on third-party services. The combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions ensures that you retain full ownership of your data and assets. This approach not only circumvents existing payment limitations but also enhances your ability to reach a global audience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, ensure you have a domain name and a basic understanding of GitHub or Cloudflare interfaces. Set up a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. You will also need to create an account with NOWPayments for handling transactions. For product delivery, consider using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file hosting. Having these components in place will streamline your deployment process, ensuring a smooth transition to your new digital storefront.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for a seamless customer experience. Start by integrating NOWPayments into your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers. This allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees. Once the payment layer is configured, set up your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Ensure your products are accessible immediately after payment confirmation, which will enhance customer satisfaction and trust in your store.
Take control of your digital sales without relying on restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and run thorough tests to confirm that all functionalities work as intended. Ensure your payment processing is operational by performing a test transaction with a small amount. Monitor the flow from payment confirmation to product delivery, making any necessary adjustments. Once satisfied, promote your store on social media and other channels to attract your first customers and begin processing real transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is live, consider scaling your operations. Monitor customer interactions and product performance to identify opportunities for expansion. You can add more products or enhance your marketing efforts. Utilize analytics tools to gain insights into customer behavior and tailor your offerings accordingly. Additionally, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack to leverage more advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations, which add layers of security and professionalism to your digital storefront.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's infrastructure. Choose Stack 01 for a quick setup using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, or opt for Stack 02 for a more robust solution with Cloudflare Pages and Workers. Both options enable you to launch a fully functional online store without traditional payment restrictions.
Deploy your crypto store in hours, not weeks.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
